proves.claim: saveItemNeeds writes the needs list that itemById reads back, an item never given needs reads an empty list, and saving an empty list clears it.

store.needs.save-and-read.why: Without this test, a regression where saveItemNeeds writes the needs list that itemById reads back, an item never given needs reads an empty list, and saving an empty list clears it would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: an unknown need is refused with USAGE naming browser and gui, and addItem with needs on a board below NEEDS_ENGINE is refused with ENGINE_VERSION.

store.needs.refuse-unknown-and-old-engin.why: Without this test, a regression where an unknown need is refused with USAGE naming browser and gui, and addItem with needs on a board below NEEDS_ENGINE is refused with ENGINE_VERSION would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: the exported addItem and editItem record the needs list through saveItemNeeds, and itemById reads it back.

store.needs.add-real-path.why: Without this test, a regression where the exported addItem and editItem record the needs list through saveItemNeeds, and itemById reads it back would pass unnoticed.
